name: Hunger
description:
Hunger - Eldritch Leader models begin the game with three hunger points. There is no limit to the number of hunger points they can have at any time. Friendly Faction models within an Eldritch Leader model’s control range can spend hunger points on that model to use a Hunger Ability. All friendly Faction models have the Shadow Shift ability.

• Shadow Shift [3] - When this model is directly hit by an enemy attack, after the attack has been resolved, it can spend three hunger points to choose another friendly Faction model within 4". This model is placed in base contact with the chosen model. The chosen model is then removed from play. Fury points cannot be reaved from a warbeast removed from play by Shadow Shift.

Continuous Effect: Torment - Until this continuous effect expires, an enemy Fane of Nyrro Eldritch Leader model gains one hunger point during each of the tormented model’s maintenance phases. Affected large-based or smaller models cannot have damage removed from them.

name: Ashmael, Keeper of Whispers
featDescription: Place a desecration token on each non-cache scenario element within Ashmael’s control range. When a friendly Faction model attacks an enemy model that is within contesting range of a scenario element with a desecration token, they gain an additional die on the attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. When you secure a scenario element with a desecration token, remove the token from it.

name: Admonition

name: Dissected Essence

name: Mirage

name: Pursuit

name: Spymaster
description:
Spymaster - The first time Ashmael hits an enemy model with each of the following types of attack each turn, he gains one hunger point: melee attack, ranged attack, arcane attack. Friendly Faction models have the following hunger abilities.

• Corrupt [6] - When the opponent scores one or more victory points by securing one of their scenario elements, Ashmael can spend six hunger points to place a corruption token on it. When you score one or more victory points by securing a scenario element with a corruption token, score one additional point and remove the token. This ability can only be used on each scenario element once per game.

• Misdirect [2] - When a friendly Faction model within 3" of this non-leader, non-incorporeal model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, this model can spend two hunger points to be directly hit by the attack instead. Each model can only use this ability once per turn.

• Stolen Fate [1] - When this model makes an attack roll, it can spend one hunger point to roll a separate die that is not added to the total. If that separate die result is the same as another die used in the attack roll, and the attack hits, it is a critical hit.

name: Attack Type

• Witch Mark - If this attack directly hits an enemy model during this model’s activation, until the end of that activation this model can target and automatically hit that enemy model with spells, ignoring RNG and LOS.

description: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Reload [1]
description: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

name: Man Catcher
description: A warrior model hit by this attack suffers –2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model’s melee range for one round.

name: True Mercenary
description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

name: Convection
description: When Convection destroys a living enemy model, you can give 1 focus point to a warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range.

name: Energizer
description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can immediately advance up to 2". Energizer can be cast only once per activation.

name: Hellwrought
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Feign Death
description: This model cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.

name: Journeyman Warcaster
description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Invictus]
description: The only warjack that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Invictus.

name: Cumbersome
description: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.

name: Powerful Attack
description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can spend 1 focus point or be forced to boost all attack and damage rolls for the attack.

name: Armor-Piercing (★Attack)
description: When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Companion [Magnus, the Unstoppable]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Magnus, the Unstoppable. If Magnus is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Magnus’ battlegroup.

name: Aggressive
description: This model can run or charge without spending a focus point.

name: Retaliatory Strike
description: If this model is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. This model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.

name: Arcing Fire
description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.

name: Critical Knockdown
description: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Sustained Attack
description: During this model’s activation, when it makes an attack with this weapon against the last model hit by the weapon this activation, the attack automatically hits.

name: Critical Knockdown
description: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

name: Thresher (★Attack)
description: This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon’s melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.

name: Blessing of the Gods
description: Play this card any time during your activation on one of your models. That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.

name: Break Through
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Unstoppable this activation.

name: Careful Reconnaissance
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Pathfinder this activation.

name: Defenses
description: Play this card at the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Barrier
description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Fire Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

name: Exploding!
description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Targetable
description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

name: Demolition
description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

name: Spike Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Duck and Cover!
description: Play this card at any time during the activation of one of your warrior units. Those models gain cover and Resistance: Blast for one round.

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Lucky Penny
description: Play this card at the start of a friendly model’s activation to give that model one corpse token, essence point, focus point, fury point, rage token, or soul token.

name: Put the Fires Out
description: Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your model/units. If the affected models were knocked down, they stand up. If the affected models were stationary, the stationary status expires. If the affected models were suffering continuous or shakable effects, like Blind or Shadow Bind, those effects expire.
